comparison.objective: Seat a platform simultaneously on three kinematic datums; candidate breaks and recovers four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine multi-contact pose alignment across cup/groove supports versus recessed coaxial tool placement, impact regulation, withdrawal, and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: All three contacts pass 0.20 mm clearance tests for one second with fingers released versus four fractures, retained inserts, contained debris, and a two-second stable state.
comparison.reason: Precision alignment is shared only generically; simultaneous datum seating does not exercise impact fracture or debris recovery. No separate spec versions were included in the indexed record.
